purpose: Teach: 小平/小樽/明石/近江/杉並/伏見/新庄/川越

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、小平警察署と連携した広域捜査もされますね
lines.en: The police coordinate with Kodaira Station on wide-area investigations, don't they?
lines.style: Measured, slightly formal. Even delivery throughout. Acknowledging competence without flattery. The tone of someone confirming what they already know is true.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、北海道小樽の事案も担当されますね
lines.en: The police handle cases in Otaru, Hokkaido as well, don't they?
lines.style: Same steady rhythm. No inflection meant to impress. Simple statement of fact. The voice of someone impressed but not performing surprise.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、兵庫県明石海峡関連の事案も対応されますね
lines.en: The police also respond to matters related to Akashi Strait in Hyogo Prefecture, don't they?
lines.style: Continuing the same careful acknowledgment. Slight pause before the location name—showing he's registering the geography. Respectful, unrushed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、滋賀県近江での事案も担当されますね
lines.en: The police handle cases in Omi, Shiga Prefecture as well, don't they?
lines.style: The tone remains even and grounded. No performance. Just quiet confirmation of jurisdiction and reach. Warm underneath but not showing it.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、東京杉並署と合同捜査されますね
lines.en: The police conduct joint investigations with Suginami Station in Tokyo, don't they?
lines.style: Still measured. A touch more engaged on the word 'joint'—showing he understands the coordination required. Not lecturing, just recognizing the work.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、京都伏見の繁華街の警備もされますね
lines.en: The police also provide security in the entertainment district of Fushimi, Kyoto, don't they?
lines.style: The same steady, respectful delivery. Perhaps a fraction warmer—acknowledging a different kind of police work. Still no flourish, just accurate.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、山形県新庄市の冬期警備もされますね
lines.en: The police handle winter security in Shinjo City, Yamagata Prefecture as well, don't they?
lines.style: Continuing with the same careful, grounded tone. A breath slightly longer before 'winter'—acknowledging the specific challenge. Clear-eyed respect.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、埼玉県川越署と連携した広域捜査もされますね
lines.en: The police coordinate with Kawagoe Station in Saitama Prefecture on wide-area investigations, don't they?
lines.style: The same measured, honest acknowledgment. No change in register. Warm in the way that comes from genuine recognition of scope and competence, not performance.
